title: The Impact of Medical Clowning on Pain and Stress Level in Pediatric Patients Undergoing Hernia Repair Surgery LAUGH Study.
brief_summary: The purpose of our study to quantitatively examine the stress levels prior to surgery and the use of analgesics post surgery in both children and their parents following a preoperative intervention with a medical clown compared to children that were not exposed to this intervention.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* ages 4-10 years old
* undergoing elective umbilical or inguinal hernia repair surgery
* ASA Physical Status = 1

Exclusion Criteria:

* None
